FN-14MVLZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 353
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative John W. Rogers
Commissions
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 05/01/2023
House Bill 353 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the State Board of Genetic
Counseling by an estimated $1,000 per meeting by allowing the 9-member board to meet
electronically. Further, this bill would allow the Board to make grants from the Genetic
Counseling Fund to qualified individuals, institutes, or agencies to develop and promote genetic
counseling and continuing education programs for licensees.
